svg.title: Linexin Center — LineXinBar glass and wallpaper
svg.desc: The original two-panel Center icon, with LXB's purple wallpaper and water ribbons on rect1, the curved context-menu glass material on rect4, and the supplied Linexin-logo-shaded2 vector logo. All artwork is SVG paths, gradients, masks and filters. No embedded or linked bitmap images. The menu has a truly translucent face, denser reflective rim, and a softly blurred vector wallpaper underneath.
